title: DigitalCalibrationCertificate
description: W3C VC 2.0 credential encoding a Digital Calibration Certificate per ISO/IEC 17025:2017 and PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0 (https://ptb.de/dcc). Issued by a calibration laboratory to a customer; verifier policy determines the sufficient authorizing evidence.

@context.description: JSON-LD context array. First item MUST be 'https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2'. Second item SHOULD be the QI-VC calibration context.

type.description: Credential type array. MUST contain 'VerifiableCredential' and 'DigitalCalibrationCertificate'.

id.description: Optional globally unique URI for this credential.

issuer.description: DID of the calibration laboratory (CAB) issuing this certificate. Maps to dcc:calibrationLaboratory in the DCC domain, providing the cryptographic identity.

validFrom.description: ISO 8601 datetime from which this credential is valid. Set to dcc:endPerformanceDate — the date calibration was completed. ISO/IEC 17025:2017 §7.8.2.

validUntil.description: ISO 8601 datetime after which this credential is no longer valid. Set only when the issuing lab specifies a recalibration due date. ISO/IEC 17025:2017 §7.8.4 note: calibration intervals are the user's responsibility.

credentialStatus.description: Revocation or suspension status. Per W3C Bitstring Status List v1.0.

credentialSchema.description: Reference to this schema for validation purposes.

credentialSubject.description: The DCC domain payload. Contains all calibration data per PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0.

evidence.description: Evidence that supports or authorizes the credential. Entries use QI evidence relations; no capability layer is required by default. W3C VC 2.0 §4.9.

proof.description: Cryptographic proof over the credential. In M1 this is a structural placeholder; real EdDSA proofs are added in M2.

DccCredentialSubject.title: DccCredentialSubject
DccCredentialSubject.description: The subject of a DigitalCalibrationCertificate. Maps to the content of a PTB DCC v3.3.0 document.

id.description: Optional DID of the calibrated item or customer. W3C VC 2.0 §4.6.

measurementResults.description: Calibration measurement results. Maps to dcc:measurementResults/dcc:result in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0.

DccAdministrativeData.title: DccAdministrativeData
DccAdministrativeData.description: Administrative metadata for the DCC. Maps to dcc:administrativeData in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0.

coreData.title: CoreData
coreData.description: Essential DCC identifiers and dates. Maps to dcc:coreData in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0.

uniqueIdentifier.description: Unique certificate identifier. Maps to dcc:uniqueIdentifier. PTB DCC XSD §administrativeData/coreData.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the calibration laboratory. Maps to dcc:countryCodeISO3166_1.

usedLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the certificate content. Maps to dcc:usedLangCodeISO639_1.

beginPerformanceDate.description: Start of calibration activity. Maps to dcc:beginPerformanceDate. ISO 8601.

endPerformanceDate.description: End of calibration — the calibration date. Maps to dcc:endPerformanceDate. ISO 8601. Equals VC validFrom.

issueDate.description: Date the certificate was formally issued. Maps to dcc:issueDate. May differ from endPerformanceDate.

performanceLocation.description: Location where calibration was performed. Maps to dcc:performanceLocation.

items.description: Calibrated equipment items. Maps to dcc:items/dcc:item in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0. Typically one item per DCC.

calibrationLaboratory.description: The calibration laboratory. Maps to dcc:calibrationLaboratory (contactType) in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0. Human-readable complement to the VC issuer DID.

customer.description: The customer who commissioned the calibration. Maps to dcc:customer (contactType) in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0. ISO/IEC 17025:2017 §7.8.2.a requires name and address of customer.

DccItem.title: DccItem
DccItem.description: An item submitted for calibration. Maps to dcc:item in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0.

name.description: Descriptive name of the item. Maps to dcc:name on dcc:item.

identifications.description: Identifiers for this item (serial number, model, inventory number, etc.). Maps to dcc:identifications/dcc:identification.

owner.description: Equipment owner (if different from customer). Maps to dcc:owner (contactType).

MeasurementResultGroup.title: MeasurementResultGroup
MeasurementResultGroup.description: A group of measurement results for one measurand with one method. Maps to dcc:result in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0.

id.description: Optional identifier for this result group, for cross-referencing. Maps to id attribute on dcc:result.

measurand.description: Human-readable label for what is being measured, e.g. 'Pressure'. Maps to dcc:name on dcc:result.

usedMethods.description: Calibration methods applied. Maps to dcc:usedMethod in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0. ISO/IEC 17025:2017 §7.2 (method selection and verification).

reference.description: Standard or SOP reference, e.g. 'EA-10/17', 'EURAMET cg-17 v4'.

influenceConditions.description: Environmental and influence conditions during calibration. Maps to dcc:influenceCondition. GUM §4.2 (identifying and quantifying influence quantities).

results.description: Individual measurement readings for this measurand. Maps to dcc:measurement/dcc:quantity in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0.

MeasurementReading.title: MeasurementReading
MeasurementReading.description: A single measurement reading within a result group. Nested as results[].data.quantity to preserve the DRMD/DCC XSD nesting and allow future extension with qualitative or count data types.

quantity.description: The measured quantity: quantityKind, value, unit, uncertainty. Maps to si:quantity / si:real in D-SI XSD v2.2.1.
